name: Traefik Manager
description: Web interface to inspect the existing Traefik (routers, services, middlewares, health) and to draft routes. Installed read-only: it reads Traefik's API, and the routes it writes stay in its own folder until an ownership plan is approved.

volumes.name: config
volumes.description: Its settings and the routes it manages (config/routes); not loaded by the live Traefik.

volumes.name: backups
volumes.description: Its own backups before every change.

inputs.label: Administrator password
inputs.help: Set with Traefik Manager's own reset command after the first start; change it later in its settings.

dependencies: The existing Traefik's API on the shared network (read-only)
security: Read-only towards the live proxy: no Docker socket, no access to the live Traefik's dynamic folder or static configuration. Routes drafted in Traefik Manager are saved in its own config/routes folder and take effect only if that folder is later given to Traefik (an explicit ownership decision).
It reads Traefik's API at http://<traefik container>:8080 over the shared network; the API has no write operations.
Never publish it without Cloudflare Access (it is an administration interface). The first sign-in runs its setup wizard.

update.notes: Its settings and route drafts are in the project folder and survive updates.
